Get Involved

No experience needed, no perfect politics required. If you want a better Valley, there's a place for you here.

How to joinCommitteesCommunication channelsCommon questions

How to join

  1. 1
    Become a member
    Sign up in a few minutes. Dues are sliding-scale — pay what you can, and no one is turned away for lack of funds.
    Join now →
  2. 2
    Come to Progress Now 101
    Our intro session for new and curious folks — what we stand for, what our chapter is working on, and how to plug in. Offered virtually and in person, multiple times a month. You don't have to be a member yet to attend.
    Find a session →
  3. 3
    Get onboarded & plug in
    After 101, we'll add you to our WhatsApp and match you with a committee that fits your interests and capacity — whether that's an hour a month or a night a week.
    Browse committees ↓

Committees

Committees are where the work happens. Each one meets regularly and welcomes new members — reach out through the WhatsApp or at any general meeting.
Political Education

Reading groups, night school, and workshops that build our shared analysis.

Mutual Aid

Meeting our neighbors' immediate needs while organizing for lasting change.

Labor

Supporting workers organizing on the job across the Valley.

Communications

Social media, design, and this website — telling the chapter's story.

Electoral

Backing candidates and ballot measures that fight for working people.

Membership & Onboarding

Welcoming new members and making sure no one falls through the cracks.
